args.title: Vault accounts
args.schema: CREATE TABLE ("Email" TITLE, "Person" RICH_TEXT, "Status" SELECT('pending':yellow, 'active':green, 'closed':gray), "Name" RICH_TEXT, "Hint" RICH_TEXT, "Key" RICH_TEXT, "Public key" RICH_TEXT, "Private key" RICH_TEXT, "Stamp" RICH_TEXT, "Hash" RICH_TEXT, "Salt" RICH_TEXT, "Kdf" NUMBER, "Iterations" NUMBER, "Memory" NUMBER, "Parallelism" NUMBER, "Created" NUMBER, "Revision" NUMBER, "Expires" NUMBER)

args.title: Vault devices
args.schema: CREATE TABLE ("Identifier" TITLE, "Account" RELATION('{{accounts.data_source_id}}'), "Name" RICH_TEXT, "Type" NUMBER, "Refresh" RICH_TEXT, "Stamp" RICH_TEXT, "Created" NUMBER, "Seen" NUMBER)

args.title: Vault shared vaults
args.schema: CREATE TABLE ("Name" TITLE, "Billing email" RICH_TEXT, "Public key" RICH_TEXT, "Private key" RICH_TEXT, "Groups" RICH_TEXT, "Status" SELECT('active':green, 'closed':gray), "Created" NUMBER, "Revision" NUMBER)

args.title: Vault shared vault members
args.schema: CREATE TABLE ("Email" TITLE, "Organization" RICH_TEXT, "Account" RELATION('{{accounts.data_source_id}}'), "Person" RICH_TEXT, "Status" SELECT('invited':yellow, 'accepted':orange, 'confirmed':green, 'revoked':gray), "Role" NUMBER, "Key" RICH_TEXT, "Source" RICH_TEXT, "Access all" CHECKBOX, "Collections" RICH_TEXT, "Groups" RICH_TEXT, "Created" NUMBER, "Revision" NUMBER)

args.title: Vault collections
args.schema: CREATE TABLE ("Name" TITLE, "Organization" RICH_TEXT, "External id" RICH_TEXT, "Revision" NUMBER)

args.title: Vault items
args.schema: CREATE TABLE ("Kind" TITLE, "Account" RELATION('{{accounts.data_source_id}}'), "Type" NUMBER, "Folder" RICH_TEXT, "Favorite" CHECKBOX, "Data" RICH_TEXT, "Created" NUMBER, "Revision" NUMBER, "Deleted" NUMBER, "Organization" RICH_TEXT, "Collections" RICH_TEXT, "Places" RICH_TEXT)
